subject.title: improve(mattermost): restart only the changed account on config reload

question: Should the channel-plugin API expose `reload.accountScopedRestart` under the documented isolation contract, with Mattermost as its first opt-in plugin?
rationale: The patch is technically sound, but adding a reusable plugin API capability and changing live reload semantics requires explicit owner intent rather than automation inferring that this is the permanent contract.

options.title: Approve the opt-in contract
options.body: Accept the documented capability and Mattermost implementation after exact-head checks complete.

options.title: Redesign the capability seam
options.body: Keep the optimization but request a narrower or richer plugin contract if a boolean isolation claim is considered too coarse.

options.title: Retain wholesale reloads
options.body: Decline account-scoped reload support and keep the existing conservative whole-channel lifecycle.

recommendation.title: Approve the opt-in contract
recommendation.body: Accept the documented capability and Mattermost implementation after exact-head checks complete.

likelyOwner.reason: The strongest available history signal is the gateway channel lifecycle and autostart-suppression behavior this PR extends.
